disposition.reason: The current VAE input and reconstruction loss have no per-timestep validity mask; measured padding or missing source bars therefore cannot be distinguished from valid values by this audit.

scope.claim_limit: Describes input completeness, resampled rows, normalization output, and fixed-shape padding only. It does not measure learned VAE quality or policy value.
scope.source_timezone_interpretation: Use timestamps and local wall-clock labels as supplied; no external calendar or timezone authority is asserted.

training_contract.candidate_registration: config/experiments.yaml registers ablation_conditional_narrative with use_vae=1; this audit does not assert that a checkpoint exists or was used in a run.
training_contract.implication: Current training data lack date/session identity and contain leading all-zero rows; random splitting and unmasked reconstruction do not establish chronological train-only fitting or distinguish padded rows from valid zero-valued inputs.
training_contract.partitioning: training/runner/vae.py::prepare_data uses random_split at 70/15/15 without a date key or explicit generator.
training_contract.reconstruction_loss: training/runner/vae.py::VAELoss uses summed MSE over every timestep and feature; there is no validity-mask argument.
training_contract.runtime_input: training/runner/data_stage.py builds pre_ny_by_date from current primary M1 bars only when --use-vae is supplied; the separate training command consumes config/vae.yaml data_path.
